stem: Why is consistency of the light and dark schedule important in a photoperiod-sensitive flowering crop?
choices: Flowering development responds to photoperiodic signaling, so irregular light exposure can disrupt the intended cue
Only total electrical wattage determines flowering
Dark periods have no biological relevance
rationale: Photoperiod-sensitive crops use light-dark timing as a developmental signal. Consistent schedules reduce unintended variation in that cue.
